working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF) cluster named 'L4' by the authors (Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, GSE156455 metadata_early subtype); composed primarily of immature L4 cells of the developing optic lobe/eye.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that will develop into an adult lamina monopolar neuron L4.

justification: Early (0-24h APF) cluster named L4 by the authors; FBbt has the matching immature term (same type, developmental stage appropriate).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A lamina monopolar neuron that arborizes in the proximal lamina, forms a spreading arbor in medulla layer M2 and a small terminal arbor in M4-M5 that penetrates adjacent columns (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Takemura et al., 2008; Takemura et al., 2011). In the medulla it forms presynaptic terminals in both M2 and M4-M5 with transmedullary neuron Tm2; three L4 neurons, one from the parent column and two from the posterior ones contact the same Tm2 neuron (Takemura et al., 2008; Takemura et al., 2011). It seems to be capable of both cholinergic and GABAergic neurotransmission.
